_readme: THIS FILE IS EMPTY ON PURPOSE. It was NOT written by an AI or by a non-speaker.
A wrong translation in a church tool is not a cosmetic bug: the volunteer running the
service reads these words under pressure, in a dark booth, with a congregation waiting.
The same rule applies here as to book_aliases.json and numerals.json — the words come
from someone who speaks the language.
TO CONTRIBUTE (no Rust, no Svelte, no build):
1. Open src/lib/locales/en.json and copy any key you want to translate.
2. Paste it here and translate the VALUE only. Leave the key exactly as it is.
3. Keep every {placeholder} — word order may change, the placeholder must survive.
4. Open a pull request. One key is a useful pull request.
Anything you leave out simply stays English, so a partial translation is a WORKING
translation and ships the day it lands. Start with the live.* keys — that is the screen
a volunteer actually uses on a Sunday.
